text:
derek: HyperFlux shipped their HyperX card samples and proposed a joint perf/W verification for our 40B model. want a compact plan so we can qualify their listing on the marketplace.
anya: scope? streaming seq len, batch sizes, which kernel knobs are on the table?
hyperflux-eng: goal: steady-state perf/W (1h trimmed mean), tokens/sec, latency p95, and kernel stability. tuning: hyperx-lowpower-v4 (prefetch=off, warp_pack=16, power_cap=210). firmware: hyperx-fw-2026-05-17. we'll provide powermeter CSV + IPMI.
derek: propose: two kernel configs (redwood-default, hyperx-lowpower-v4), run each 2x for 1h with 15m warmup, measure last 45m. power sample 1s, thermals 5s. also require a calibration step.
pm-cleo: PM ask: reproducible bundle for partner QA please. include docker tag, env.sample, run.sh, and a README. we'll host under experiments/hyperflux/ once ready.
hyperflux-eng: we'll drop a flash script and a small validation script that compares logits to host baseline within epsilon.
derek: collector schema we need (strings keys): run_id, partner, model, kernel_label, firmware_id, batch_size, seq_len, tokens_per_sec, power_mean_w, power_p95_w, thermal_max_c, latency_p50_ms, latency_p95_ms, panic_count, raw_power_series_url, artifact_url, bench_git_sha. include measured_window_start and measured_window_end.
anya: note on KV cache: warmup bias. we'll implement a 10m warmup and only compute metrics on the trimmed window. also upload raw series so partners can re-trim if desired.
hyperflux-eng: we can expose both IPMI and an external powermeter trace. powermeter timestamps are ms precision and in UTC.
derek: sample run id and command I'll add to the runbook:
```
RUN_ID="hyperflux-hyperx-2026-10-05-01"
./run_bench --model redwood-40b --seq 8192 --batch 4 --streaming --duration 3600 --warmup 900 --collector http://collector.internal:8200/post --tag "$RUN_ID"
```
ops-bot: Available lab slots: 2026-10-05 20:00 PT or 2026-10-06 02:00 PT. Please confirm preferred.
derek: prefer 2026-10-05 20:00 PT. ops-bot: booking confirmed: hyperflux-bay-1 2026-10-05T20:00:00-07:00 booking_id=HB-10459
pm-cleo: marketing/comms: if numbers validate we want a co-branded marketplace tile + a one-page case study. legal embargo?
legal: legal: 72-hour embargo after validated numbers, MOU required. we'll send a template.
anya: infra notes: run on 3 identical nodes in perf-pool, isolated VLAN, NTP/chrony sync, local collector, and watchdog that restarts hung runs and records reboot events. add a 5m fixed-load calibration at start.
derek: risk list: thermal plateau after ~50m on early silicon, powermeter drift, IPMI dropouts, network jitter affecting streaming. mitigations: preflight thermal stress, redundant powermeter, disable auto-updates, and isolated ingest gateway.
hyperflux-eng: we'll disable auto-update and run stress-ng before the official run. we'll also provide a small script to collect kernel oops and dmesg.
pm-cleo: action items: derek -> perf script + baseline hosted runs; hyperflux-eng -> kernel toggle script + powermeter manifest; anya -> infra + collector mapping + watchdog; pm-cleo -> reproducibility bundle + comms; legal -> MOU template. dry-run: 2026-10-03 09:00 PT; official: 2026-10-05 20:00 PT.
derek: I'll post a short runbook under experiments/hyperflux/runbook.md in ~1h and tag the team for preflight. ping here when artifacts uploaded. :rocket:
